title: sketch
body:
## sketch

Build a general native Sketcher profile from named lines, circles and circular arcs, including construction geometry. Fixed mode creates editable Block constraints for the authored geometry; solve mode uses named dimensional/geometric relations and requires zero remaining freedom. References use geometry names and point roles, not native indices. Initial solve-mode coordinates seed the solver; independent host residual checks judge the solved geometry. Use rectangle, circle or slot shortcuts for ordinary dimensioned profiles.

Native binding: `Sketcher::SketchObject`. Output kind: `["profile"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | no | `body` |
| `support` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geometry` | Ordered named local planar geometry for the sketch. Lines, circles and circular arcs can be ordinary or construction geometry. Fixed mode blocks each element; solve mode preserves the selected native relations instead of these initial coordinates. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","required":true},"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["line"],"required":true},"construction":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"start":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2,"required":true},"end":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2,"required":true}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","required":true},"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["circle"],"required":true},"construction":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"centre":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2,"required":true},"radius":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000,"required":true}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","required":true},"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["arc"],"required":true},"construction":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"centre":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2,"required":true},"radius":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000,"required":true},"startAngle":{"type":"number","minimum":-360,"maximum":360,"required":true},"endAngle":{"type":"number","minimum":-360,"maximum":720,"required":true}}}]},"minItems":1,"maxItems":200}` | **required** |
| `constraints` | Ordered named constraints used only in solve mode. Geometry names and point roles express relations without authored native indices. Native solve/fully-constrained checks and independent host residual checks must both succeed. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","required":true},"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["coincident","horizontal","vertical","parallel","perpendicular","tangent","equal","distance","distanceX","distanceY","radius","diameter","angle","block"],"required":true},"first":{"type":"object","properties":{"geometry":{"type":"string","required":true},"point":{"type":"enum","values":["start","end","centre","whole"],"default":"whole"}},"required":true},"second":{"type":"object","properties":{"geometry":{"type":"string","required":true},"point":{"type":"enum","values":["start","end","centre","whole"],"default":"whole"}}},"value":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000}}},"minItems":0,"maxItems":500}` | `[]` |
| `constraintMode` | fixed (default) blocks complete geometry at authored coordinates. solve accepts named relations and requires a fully constrained solution; omit constraints in fixed mode. Rectangle/circle/slot shortcuts provide common fully constrained dimensional intent automatically. | `{"type":"enum","values":["fixed","solve"]}` | `"fixed"` |
| `plane` | Sketch plane XY (default), XZ or YZ, or the native Body origin mirror plane for mirror. Profile local coordinates follow that plane; explicit frame and onFace attachment provide separate placement choices. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"XY"` |
| `origin` | World X/Y/Z sketch or datum origin in mm, default zero. For a profile it combines with the plane shortcut; explicit frame or onFace must replace non-default plane/origin. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `frame` | An independent right-handed sketch frame: origin in world mm, perpendicular unit xAxis and normal, with local Y defined as normal cross xAxis. Use this instead of plane/origin or onFace; it remains a native placement rather than a linked attachment. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"origin":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"xAxis":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"normal":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true}}}` | omitted |
| `onFace` | Native planar-face attachment intent, paired with support. Select one extreme outward-facing planar face by semantic direction, anchor and offset; ambiguous or missing faces fail. The persisted native support link follows compatible native support edits. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"face":{"type":"enum","values":["top","bottom","right","left","back","front"],"required":true},"position":{"type":"enum","values":["outermost","innermost"],"default":"outermost"},"anchor":{"type":"enum","values":["projectOrigin","centroid"],"default":"projectOrigin"},"offset":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000,"default":0}}}` | omitted |
